note: **the discriminating case is a WAL-resident write with the writer connection still open**: mutate through the facade, do NOT checkpoint, then assert the snapshot contains the mutation. Measured 2026-08-15 on the real shape -- live 50 rows, `VACUUM INTO` 50, naive `cp` **0**, and the bad copy opens cleanly and reports no error. A test that closes the DB before snapshotting PASSES ON THE DEFECT, because a lone reader closing cleanly checkpoints and truncates the WAL; that is how the first attempt at this measurement failed to reproduce it
